The d-pad is terrible. I honestly do not know how that d-pad made it out of testing and in to production. The d-pad is actually on a little stick and it has lateral movement, so if you push the d-pad to the right the plastic d-pad will hit the housing before it registers any downward input, i.e. an actual button press.

If you can, get an Xbone pad instead. It has a much better d-pad. One of the best I've ever used, actually. Other than that they are very similar.
